summary.zh: 规划 Expo、导航、原生模块与离线同步
summary.en: Plan Expo, navigation, native modules, and offline sync

description.zh: 覆盖 Expo 工程结构、路由导航、原生模块接入和离线数据同步，用于搭建可上线的跨平台移动应用。适合新项目立项或接入原生能力时参考。接入原生模块需要配置对应平台的构建环境。
description.en: Covers Expo project structure, navigation, native module bridging, and offline sync for production cross-platform apps. Native modules require platform build tooling.
